name: Kempinski Hotel Riga
positioning: Grand Hotel Kempinski Riga, an Old Town hotel with a direct view of the Latvian National Opera House
best_for: Travelers who want an Old Town base close to Riga's sights
Families who like a hotel tour for children

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Riga's Old Town, with a direct view of the Latvian National Opera House.
The House of the Blackheads is listed 0.6 km from the hotel.
The Freedom Monument is listed 0.3 km from the hotel.
Riga International Airport is 9 km from the hotel.
Riga Central Train and Bus Stations are 600 m from the hotel.
A transfer service runs between the hotel and Riga Airport, the Central Train Station, the Coach Station and Riga Passenger Port.
The hotel has Stage22 Bar & Restaurant.
A dog-approved menu is available in the hotel's restaurants and for in-room dining.
Olympic Casino at the hotel offers table games, slot machines and sports betting.
The concierge can help with opera or ballet tickets, restaurant reservations and private jets.

highlights.text: Guests are welcomed by the Lady & Gentleman in Red, a host dressed in red with knowledge of the hotel and the local area.
The hotel can organise a bespoke hotel tour for children, based on the child's age and interests.
The children's hotel tour finishes with a cocoa drink in the Lobby Lounge.
A dog-approved menu is available in the hotel's restaurants and for in-room dining.

considerations.text: A tourism tax of EUR 1 per visitor per night is added to the hotel bill in Riga.
Pets stay for a supplement of EUR 55 per night, which covers the hotel's pet amenities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
